stories.story_fr: Perte nette de 593 M$ due à un développement défavorable des réserves en assurance dommages aux États‑Unis.
stories.story_en: Net loss of $593 million driven by unfavorable reserve development in U.S. casualty lines.
stories.quote: Net Loss of $593 million; Net Operating Loss of $780 million driven primarily by net unfavorable development of prior year loss reserves in U.S. casualty lines

stories.story_fr: Flux de trésorerie opérationnel record de 5,0 M$ pour l'année 2024.
stories.story_en: Record operating cashflow of $5.0 billion for 2024.
stories.quote: Strong operating cashflow for the year of $5.0 billion, a company record

stories.story_fr: Le ratio combiné du groupe a atteint 102,3 % au quatrième trimestre 2024, indiquant une sous‑performance souscriptionnelle.
stories.story_en: Group combined ratio rose to 102.3% in Q4 2024, indicating underwriting pressure.
stories.quote: Combined ratios of 102.3% for the Group

stories.story_fr: Revenus nets d'investissement ont atteint environ 2 M$ en 2024, un nouveau record historique.
stories.story_en: Net investment income topped roughly $2 billion in 2024, a company record.
stories.quote: Net investment income increased over $500 million to ≈$2 billion, a company record

stories.story_fr: Les pertes catastrophes pré‑fiscales ont bondi à 672 M$ au quatrième trimestre 2024, contre 451 M$ l'année précédente.
stories.story_en: Pre‑tax catastrophe losses surged to $672 million in Q4 2024, up from $451 million a year earlier.
stories.quote: $672 million of pre‑tax catastrophe losses net of recoveries and reinstatement premiums, versus $451 million in the prior year
